question.en: Discuss the significance of the Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) in transforming India's logistics landscape and boosting the manufacturing sector.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of the Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) in transforming India's logistics landscape and boosting the manufacturing sector.

structure.en: Introduction: Define DFC and its purpose.
structure.hi: Introduction: Define DFC and its purpose.

structure.en: Body: Explain how it reduces logistics costs, improves efficiency, and supports 'Make in India'.
structure.hi: Body: Explain how it reduces logistics costs, improves efficiency, and supports 'Make in India'.

structure.en: Conclusion: Mention the long-term impact on economic growth.
structure.hi: Conclusion: Mention the long-term impact on economic growth.

introduction.en: The Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) is a flagship infrastructure project aimed at creating high-capacity, high-speed rail corridors exclusively for freight movement.
introduction.hi: The Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) is a flagship infrastructure project aimed at creating high-capacity, high-speed rail corridors exclusively for freight movement.

body.en: It addresses the issue of congestion on existing tracks, allowing for faster transit times and higher load capacities. By reducing logistics costs, it enhances the competitiveness of Indian manufacturing, directly supporting the 'Make in India' initiative. It also promotes environmental sustainability by shifting freight from road to rail.

conclusion.en: The DFC is a transformative project that will integrate India's industrial hubs and significantly contribute to the goal of becoming a $5 trillion economy.
conclusion.hi: The DFC is a transformative project that will integrate India's industrial hubs and significantly contribute to the goal of becoming a $5 trillion economy.

valueAddition.en: Logistics cost in India is currently around 13–14% of GDP, which DFC aims to reduce to single digits.
